items.source:
Return the MongoClient instance to connect to. Annotate with Bean in case you want to expose a MongoClient instance to the ApplicationContext.
Override MongoConfigurationSupport.mongoClientSettings() to configure connection details.
items.translation:
返回用于连接的 MongoClient 实例。如果您希望将 MongoClient 实例暴露给 ApplicationContext，请添加 Bean 注解。
重写 MongoConfigurationSupport.mongoClientSettings() 以配置连接详情。

items.source: Creates a MappingMongoConverter using the configured mongoDbFactory() and MongoConfigurationSupport.mongoMappingContext(MongoCustomConversions, org.springframework.data.mongodb.MongoManagedTypes). Will get MongoConfigurationSupport.customConversions() applied.
items.translation: 使用配置的mongoDbFactory()和MongoConfigurationSupport.mongoMappingContext(MongoCustomConversions, org.springframework.data.mongodb.MongoManagedTypes)创建一个MappingMongoConverter。将应用MongoConfigurationSupport.customConversions()。

items.source: Creates a SimpleMongoClientDatabaseFactory to be used by the MongoTemplate. Will use the MongoClient instance configured in mongoClient().
items.translation: 创建一个SimpleMongoClientDatabaseFactory，供MongoTemplate使用。该工厂将使用在mongoClient()中配置的实例。
